svg.text: ONE TO MOVE AND ONE TO READ, OR ONE THAT DOES BOTH
separate parts, each doing one job
one part serving several functions at once
The palace's own case: a knob with a light beside it, against a motor that both senses and pushes,
so what the synth is doing comes back through the thing already in the hand.
The right-hand part wears the Haptic Handwheel's avatar. Nothing is built yet.
